notes: Both values check as Adamec's literature summary. His own data (20 °C, 0.20 mM CO2, 400 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹ PAR, six species): dark respiration of bladders 5.1–8.6 mmol O2 kg⁻¹ FW h⁻¹, 75–200 % above that of leaves (1.7–6.1); net photosynthesis of leaves/shoots 40–117 vs bladders 5.2–14.7 mmol kg⁻¹ FW h⁻¹ (7–10× lower in bladders); bladders 4.1–6.0 % dry matter. These matter if the model charges a respiration cost for traps.
